Header.value: CampNet · Stage A: Read and label the text
Read both text sections. Mark words that support a persuasion technique, then explain your decision.
1. Mark evidence → 2. Choose techniques → 3. Report problems → 4. Check and submit.
Text only: save this stage before viewing the picture. Do not change this decision after seeing the full post.
A technique is a way of influencing what people think, feel, or do. Political content or criticism alone is not enough. You are not checking whether a claim is true.
1. Read the text and mark evidence
For each text section: click a technique button, then drag across the exact words that support it. Fill in the explanation that appears below that section. Repeat for each piece of evidence.

To review or fix a mark, click its highlighted words. If you marked the wrong words, select the mark and use Label Studio's delete control, then highlight again. If there is no supporting evidence, leave the text unmarked.

Panel.value: Need help choosing? Open the technique guide

Header.value: T01 · Loaded language
Emotionally judgmental words shape the reader's opinion. Find the exact word adding praise or blame beyond a plain description.
T02 · Name calling / labeling
A judgmental name is given to a person or group. Identify the label and who receives it.
T03 · Smears
An accusation or degrading connection attacks someone's reputation. An ordinary request for accountability is not enough.
T04 · Appeal to fear / prejudice
A threat or negative belief about a group pushes the audience toward a choice. A reasonable safety warning is not automatically this technique.
T05 · Exaggeration / minimisation
The message inflates or plays down scale, importance, or consequences. An unchecked number alone is not enough.
T06 · Slogans
A short, memorable phrase rallies support or action. A short sentence or neutral quotation alone is not enough.
T07 · Strong emotions (Stage B: picture evidence required)
CampNet requires picture evidence for this technique. Assess it in Stage B. Emotional words alone may support T01, but do not support T07.
Check whether the author supports, neutrally quotes, or rejects the message. More than one technique is allowed only when you can explain the evidence for each.

Before you submit
• Read both text sections and their notices.
• Match each selected technique to highlighted evidence. Check every highlight's claim number, reason, and confidence.
• For a completed review, choose either supported techniques or no technique. Do not choose both.
• Record any problem, choose a review status, and save your final note.
Finish: use Label Studio's Submit button. If a required-field message appears, return to the named section or click the relevant highlight to complete its answers.
